boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct SLU study environments with official details on equipment, capacity, reservation, or first-come access.

cards.title: Collaboration Studio
cards.subtitle: Academic Technology Commons, Pius XII Memorial Library
cards.notes: Reserve a study area through D!bs when your group needs whiteboard walls, a wireless display, and movable boards for project work.
cards.evidence_claim: The ATC Collaboration Studio has reservable study areas with floor-to-ceiling whiteboard walls, mobile whiteboards, and wireless presentation capability.
cards.access_notes: Study areas are reservable on D!bs; library reservation policy requires the reserving person to be a current SLU student, faculty member, or staff member.

cards.title: Idea Lab F
cards.subtitle: Academic Technology Commons, Pius XII Memorial Library
cards.notes: Book this four-person Idea Lab through D!bs for a brainstorm that benefits from movable furniture, whiteboards, and a connected touch display.
cards.short_summary: A compact reservable room built for collaborative ideation.
cards.evidence_claim: Idea Lab F is a reservable Pius Library space with a maximum capacity of four; ATC Idea Labs provide movable furniture, whiteboards, embedded touch displays, and wePresent.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through the library’s room-reservation system; one reservation of up to three hours per patron per day, up to seven days ahead.

cards.title: Idea Lab G
cards.subtitle: Academic Technology Commons, Pius XII Memorial Library
cards.notes: Use this four-person Idea Lab when you want to spread out sketches or slides, then connect a device to the room’s collaborative technology.
cards.short_summary: Another small, reservable ATC collaboration room.
cards.evidence_claim: Idea Lab G is a reservable Pius Library space with a maximum capacity of four; ATC Idea Labs include floor-to-ceiling whiteboards and embedded touch displays for student devices.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through the library’s room-reservation system; users without a reservation must yield the room to a group with a LibCal confirmation.

cards.title: Mediascape A
cards.subtitle: Academic Technology Commons, Pius XII Memorial Library
cards.notes: Reserve this eight-person ATC space when a larger team needs a defined room for planning, reviewing material, or practicing a presentation.
cards.evidence_claim: Mediascape A is listed among Pius Library’s reservable first-floor ATC spaces and has a maximum capacity of eight people.
cards.access_notes: Reservations are available to current SLU students, faculty, and staff; room capacity must be observed.

cards.title: Huddle Space A
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Pius XII Memorial Library
cards.notes: Reserve this six-person huddle space for a focused group session; bring your own dry-erase supplies or ask Patron Services for a marker packet.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor option sized for a mid-size team.
cards.evidence_claim: Huddle Space A is a reservable second-floor Pius Library study space with a maximum capacity of six people.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through the library’s online room-reservation system; most Pius rooms and spaces have tables, chairs, and whiteboards and/or chalkboards.

cards.title: Conference Studio 101 B
cards.subtitle: First floor, Academic Technology Commons at Pius Library
cards.notes: Choose this larger first-floor room for a project meeting or presentation rehearsal, keeping the group within its posted twelve-person capacity.
cards.short_summary: The largest listed first-floor ATC reservable room.
cards.evidence_claim: Conference Studio 101 B is a reservable first-floor ATC room in Pius Library with a maximum capacity of 12 people.
cards.access_notes: Current SLU students, faculty, and staff may reserve rooms; the reservation holder must be present and able to show confirmation if needed.

cards.title: Editing Pod 101C
cards.subtitle: First floor, Academic Technology Commons at Pius Library
cards.notes: Reserve this one-person editing pod when you need a defined solo workstation for concentrated media or assignment work in the ATC.
cards.short_summary: A reservable single-user pod in the library’s technology hub.
cards.evidence_claim: Editing Pod 101C is a reservable first-floor ATC space in Pius Library with a maximum capacity of one person.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through the library’s room system; Pius states that reservable rooms are unlocked, with priority given to the group holding the confirmation.

cards.title: Pius Library Room 406
cards.subtitle: Fourth floor, Pius XII Memorial Library
cards.notes: Check 25Live before heading up: use this formal classroom as a first-come study room only when it is not scheduled for a class or event.
cards.short_summary: A flexible classroom that becomes drop-in study space when open.
cards.evidence_claim: Pius Library Room 406 is a formal classroom available for general first-come-first-served use when it is not scheduled for classes or events.
cards.access_notes: Availability can change daily; check 25Live. Users may be asked to vacate for a scheduled event, and the room cannot be reserved while classes are in session.

cards.title: Pius Library Room 501
cards.subtitle: Fifth floor, Pius XII Memorial Library
cards.notes: Use this classroom for drop-in work after confirming it is unscheduled in 25Live; remain ready to move if a scheduled event begins.
cards.short_summary: A first-come classroom study option on Pius’s fifth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Pius Library Room 501 is a formal classroom available for general first-come-first-served use when it is not scheduled for classes or events.
cards.access_notes: Availability can change daily; check 25Live. Users may be asked to vacate for a scheduled event, and the room cannot be reserved while classes are in session.

cards.title: Shanahan Atrium
cards.subtitle: Cook Hall, Richard A. Chaifetz School of Business
cards.notes: Set up at a table or leather seating area for independent work, and use the available wireless access; special events may share the atrium.
cards.short_summary: An open Cook Hall atrium with seating and wireless access.
cards.evidence_claim: SLU describes Shanahan Atrium as a place to meet, study, or relax, with tables, leather furniture, and wireless access; it is also used for special events and programming.
cards.access_notes: Open study seating is described by SLU; the atrium is also used for special events and programming, so conditions may vary.
